📢 GOA SCHOOL RECRUITMENT 2026–27 | MULTIPLE VACANCIES

Looking for a teaching or non-teaching job in Goa? Several schools across Goa have announced recruitment for the academic year 2026–27.

🏫 Chowgule International School, Margao – Educators, Co-Curricular Educators, Special Educators and other vacancies.

🏫 Assagao Union High School, Bardez – Watchman (VIII Passed).

🏫 Spring Valley Higher Secondary School, Pilerne – Grade-I Teacher (History and Konkani).

🏫 DCT’s Vasantrao Dempo Higher Secondary School, Cujira – Teacher Grade-I (Economics, Konkani and Hindi).

🏫 St. Mary of the Angels Convent High School, Chinchinim – Female Trained Graduate Teachers and Female Primary Teacher.

🏫 St. Xavier’s Academy, Old Goa– Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Child Care Leave Vacancy (180 Days).

📅 Interview dates and other recruitment details vary for each institution. Check the respective recruitment notices for complete information.

Samagra Shiksha, Government of Goa – Walk-In Interview!

Goa Samagra Shiksha invites applications from eligible candidates for contractual Instructor positions across 12 different NSQF sectors.

Sectors Available:
1. Automobile
2. Tourism & Hospitality
3. Healthcare
4. Plumbing
5. Logistics
6. Electronics
7. Agriculture
8. Media & Entertainment
9. Retail
10. Banking, Financial Services & Insurance
11. Telecommunication
12. Construction

Salary: ₹20,000 per month

Interview Dates: 5th & 6th November 2026 
Reporting Time: 9:45 AM 
Interview Time: 10:00 AM 
Venue: Directorate of Education, Porvorim, Goa

Important Requirements:
- Valid 15-year Residence Certificate
- Valid Employment Registration Certificate
- Knowledge of Konkani is essential; Marathi is desirable.
- Excellent communication and basic computer skills.
- Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualifications and experience criteria for the respective sectors.

Important: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of photocopies, including educational certificates, mark sheets, age proof, address proof and other relevant certificates.

The appointment will be on a contractual basis until 31st March 2027.

Interested candidates are advised to check the complete sector-wise eligibility criteria and instructions in the official advertisement before attending the interview.
